support_claim: The registry row identifies 4721193 as MERIDIAN ENERGY PARTNERS LLC and the billing record names Meridian Energy Partners LLC, but no observation links the billing referent to that registry identifier.
justification: Under the relation contract, SAME_ENTITY requires establishing identity and DISTINCT requires establishing distinctness; the packet grounds each referent independently via name-matching excerpts without evidence that affirms or denies they denote the same legal counterparty.
